- 3:50 PM — Pulse demonstration confirmed for 4:30 PM.
- 4:05 PM — Ritesh reports a loose power cable near the stage.
- 4:09 PM — Ritesh marks the cable secured after inspection.
- 4:12 PM — Karthik writes: “Faculty cancelled Pulse — electrical concern.”
- 4:13 PM — Pulse is removed from the running order.
- 4:35 PM — Ananya arrives and disputes the cancellation.

The sheet does not identify who gave Karthik the cancellation instruction.

| Time | Record | Duration | Note |
|---|---|---:|---|
| 4:07 PM | Outgoing call to faculty office | 00:00 | No answer |
| 4:10 PM | Incoming call, caller ID withheld | 00:18 | Answered by Sana |
| 4:11 PM | Outgoing call to Karthik | 00:00 | No answer |
| 4:14 PM | Incoming call from faculty office | 00:00 | Missed |

The desk system records call duration. A duration of `00:00` means the call did not connect in this system. It does not reveal what a caller intended to say.

Karthik says:

*“At about 4:11, the faculty office called me and confirmed the cancellation. I wrote it down immediately. I wouldn't stop a team's demonstration without approval.”*

He says he did not speak to Sana before making the announcement.

- 4:05 PM — Loose cable reported.
- 4:09 PM — Cable secured and tested.
- 4:10 PM — Stage power checked; no continuing fault recorded.
- 4:30 PM — Pulse demonstration remains listed as safe to proceed, pending normal start checks.
